searchText: <@!364458974906548225> this is amazing work! https://snakecharmers.ethereum.org/beam-sync-in-80-seconds-using-meta-witnesses/ Hmm any reason why it's just node hashes for now? Why not a list of addresses and storage keys? Just ease of implementation to get something out the door got it There's one awkward piece for using addresses & storage keys: there are sometimes intermediate nodes used that aren't obviously tied to any particular key (during trie refactoring when calculating the new state root) right, so you would need to actually have a "fetch me a branch" protocol Doesn't that exist already for light clients? Yeah, quite a bit of this is motivated by the difficulty of finding light servers aha I see <@!273808422753796097> amazing work credit goes to <@!425615769280315392> & <@!482518216019542016> , they did the heavy lifting. I'm just a talking bobble head that people seem to listen to sometimes.
